head: kho
rule: ขอ is two unrelated words under one spelling — the HOOK (1), the iron goad and the hooked implement, and the verb ASK (2) — so filing this head is separation, not gradation. Everything made of or handled with a hook files at 1, including เหลือขอ, the elephant the goad no longer holds. Everything spoken files at 2, including the frozen-request politeness formulas ขอรับ, ขอเดชะ, ขอที, which are no longer felt as asking but are built from it. The ว่าน plant (3) takes nothing.
